premise: Pteranodon hops over to the mud puddle and sees a pteranodon in it; she waves, it waves; a breeze ripples it away and she's sad, until the water goes still and Archaeopteryx, peering in beside her, finds one of herself too — and Pteranodon decides the friend beside her is the best one.
inspiration: Aesop's 'The Dog and Its Reflection' turned kind: no greed, no loss — the friend in the water was her all along, and a real friend comes to look.
lesson: A real friend beside you is the best kind.

en-US.title: The Friend in the Puddle
en-US.text: {puddle:enter} [curious] {pteranodon:enter} Pteranodon was thirsty. {pteranodon:go to puddle by hop} She hopped over to the mud puddle for a drink. {pteranodon:face surprised} And there in the shiny water was another pteranodon, looking back at her! Same crest. Same long beak. [excited] "Hello!" said Pteranodon. {pteranodon:live wave} She waved. The other one waved too. {pteranodon:face happy} "Will you be my friend?" Then… {canvas:wind 0.3} {puddle:live shimmer} {sfx:breeze} a little breeze ruffled the water, and the other pteranodon wobbled… and was gone. {pteranodon:face sad} [sad] "Come back!" {archaeopteryx:enter} {archaeopteryx:go to puddle by hop} Archaeopteryx came hopping over. "What's the matter?" "My friend in the puddle went away." {archaeopteryx:live peck} Archaeopteryx bent down to the water, smooth and still again. {archaeopteryx:face surprised} "Look! There's an archaeopteryx in there! And your pteranodon is back!" {pteranodon:face surprised} {pteranodon:live tilt-head} Pteranodon tipped her head. The pteranodon in the water tipped hers. She lifted a wing. So did the other one. [gasps] "Oh! She's… ME!" {pteranodon:face happy} {pteranodon:live laugh} She laughed and laughed. {archaeopteryx:hearts} "Then you've got two friends," said Archaeopteryx. "One in the puddle, and one right here." {pteranodon:hearts} [happily] And Pteranodon decided the one right here was the best.

es-ES.title: La amiga del charco
es-ES.text: {puddle:enter} [curious] {pteranodon:enter} Pteranodon tenía sed. {pteranodon:go to puddle by hop} Se acercó dando saltitos al charco de barro para beber. {pteranodon:face surprised} Y allí, en el agua brillante, había otra pteranodon, ¡mirándola a ella! La misma cresta. El mismo pico largo. [excited] —¡Hola! —dijo Pteranodon. {pteranodon:live wave} Saludó con el ala. La otra también saludó. {pteranodon:face happy} —¿Quieres ser mi amiga? Y entonces… {canvas:wind 0.3} {puddle:live shimmer} {sfx:breeze} una brisita rizó el agua, y la otra pteranodon tembló… y desapareció. {pteranodon:face sad} [sad] —¡Vuelve! {archaeopteryx:enter} {archaeopteryx:go to puddle by hop} Arqueoptérix llegó dando saltitos. —¿Qué te pasa? —Mi amiga del charco se ha ido. {archaeopteryx:live peck} Arqueoptérix se agachó hasta el agua. Ya estaba lisa y quieta otra vez. {archaeopteryx:face surprised} —¡Mira! ¡Aquí dentro hay una arqueoptérix! ¡Y ha vuelto tu pteranodon! {pteranodon:face surprised} {pteranodon:live tilt-head} Pteranodon ladeó la cabeza. La del agua ladeó la suya. Levantó un ala. La otra, también. [gasps] —¡Oh! ¡Si soy… YO! {pteranodon:face happy} {pteranodon:live laugh} Y se rio con ganas. {archaeopteryx:hearts} —Entonces tienes dos amigas —dijo Arqueoptérix—: una en el charco, y otra aquí mismo. {pteranodon:hearts} [happily] Y Pteranodon decidió que la de aquí mismo era la mejor.
